objective.title: Qualify one bounded exact dimension-aware quantity pipeline for direct and fluent APIs

declared.summary: Activate M2-W02-C02 and qualify a bounded exact-quantity evaluator shared by public direct and immutable fluent APIs, with dimensional prevalidation, zero-divisor/affine/numeral/step bounds, exact 5 km / 2 min = 150 km/h acceptance, controlled public-contract RED, ten GREEN tests and locked package/regression checks.
declared.value: Consumers obtain an exact, dimension-safe, provider-independent linear quantity pipeline rather than a second duplicate execution path; invalid mass+time addition is refused before arithmetic.
debtChanges: M2-W02-C02-T2 remains planned: strengthen step provenance, resource, cancellation and integration boundaries independently before closing C02.
The pipeline admits explicitly supplied zero-offset linear units and rational quantities, not an open expression grammar or absolute affine temperature semantics.
The closed Start/Convert/Divide/Add pipeline is exact local arithmetic only; provider execution, AURA permission, scheduler and symbolic evaluation are not implied.
The composition NuGet package adds an explicit dw.quantities dependency alongside dw.tools.math.ir, retaining a locked graph; no external publishing or consumer adoption.
declared.nextAction: Qualify M2-W02-C02-T2 with independent adversarial resource and integration oracles, exact step provenance and explicit cancellation/non-provider boundary policy; close C02 only when all qualified.

achievements.achievement: An independently compiled RED test observes the absence of a public shared direct/fluent exact quantity evaluator before installation.
An immutable bounded typed pipeline reuses dw.quantities and a single direct/fluent engine with dimensional prevalidation and exact canonical rational arithmetic.

Ten independent GREEN tests demonstrate exact 5 km / 2 min = 150 km/h, direct/fluent parity, invalid-dimensional pre-rejection, nonaffine units, zero division, resource budgets and immutability, with package and regression qualification.
The first contract/outcome task of M2-W02-C02 is complete without closing C02 or claiming providers, AURA permission or execution beyond bounded exact local arithmetic.
